notes: ESAMT subsidiary, Castle Ward near the House of Gems. Manager Nandini Chettiar (Durpari, Gemology-16, Merchant-14, Detect Lies-13); banking Helena Brightwater/NCF; legal Merileth Dawntracker. Four products: appraisal (TSA Guardian Pledge subcontract as anchor client), gem-backed pawn lending (client surrenders the piece, 3-6 month terms), wholesale gem supply to the Institut and B&D (claimed 20-35% materials saving), curated retail. BG sourcing trip complete, Nandini recruited. Building acquisition pending - capital is the concept doc's ESTIMATE of 12,000-15,000 for Castle Ward stone commercial, not a price. Launch target Autumn 1494, ~Day 1080-1100 = 23 Marpenoth to 13 Uktar 1494. Nandini's terms: keeps her BG suppliers, sets her own standards, equity review Autumn 1496. NO RATES ARE SET ANYWHERE: no appraisal fee, no pawn interest, no loan-to-value, no wholesale margin. WHOLESALE CHECK (derived): the concept says wholesale 'alone justifies the operation'.
